# Senior FDE Recruiter Screen

[← Databricks](../README.md) · [Every Databricks question](../../databricks.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/senior-fde-recruiter-screen)

`culture-fit` `fit` `verbal` `why-company`

---

## Requirements

Get ready to answer these recruiter questions succinctly:

- Give your current city so the recruiter can check it against your resume.
- Tell why you applied for this particular position.
- Describe how your background aligns with the role.
- Share what you know about Databricks.
- Have questions ready about the role and team; one account characterized the position as a reshaped data-engineering group looking for stronger full-stack skills.

## Notes

This is a culture-fit screening, not a technical assessment. Your motivation for the role and solid knowledge of the company are assessed early in the conversation.

## Preparation

- Practice a three-minute pitch that covers your location, motivation for the role, fit, and company knowledge—without relying on notes.
- Write a 60-second fit response linking two relevant achievements to the responsibilities outlined in the job description.
- Prepare three questions about the role and team, one of which should clarify the line between data-engineering and full-stack duties.
